title: The Mystery Sinking in the Midsummer Pool
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Ran, Sonoko, Masumi Sera, Inspector Megure, Officer Takagi) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. case_type: murder. Discrepancies vs. the old cases/ file: (1) the old file's clue c2 and event e1 state the victim Nagami 'herself caused' the hit-and-run that killed the culprit's family -- the transcript instead has Nagami as a passenger in a friend's car ('the friend's car that she was riding on got into a traffic accident'); her culpable act was calling Toyoshima to demand he give her a false alibi placing her in the hotel the whole time, which is what actually revealed her connection to the crash to him. (2) the old file only lists Nagami as a victim node; the transcript makes clear three more people died in that backstory accident -- Toyoshima's younger sister, her husband, and their son who was about to turn three -- none of whom appeared in the old file despite being central to the motive. (3) the old file omits Samaki, Hamaka's rumored-affair red-herring motive and the family relationships (fiance/half-sister/employer) entirely. The culprit identification itself (Ensaku Toyoshima, hotel manager) matches the transcript and is correct.

clues.desc: The pool bottom held no glass ten minutes before the body surfaced, yet shattered pieces that reassemble into an aquarium shape were found there right after -- proves an object was deliberately introduced and destroyed between those two checks.
The one person whose foot was cut by the shattered aquarium glass is also the one with a reason to want that same glass unidentifiable -- nobody suspects the person the evidence itself injured.
